extracted.name: Air Fryer Jalapeño Poppers
extracted.description: These air fryer jalapeño poppers are stuffed with two cheeses and salami, wrapped in bacon, and cooked until browned and melty.
ingredient_lines: 1 ounce shredded Cheddar cheese, or to taste
6 medium jalapeno peppers, halved and seeded
6 slices bacon, cut in half lengthwise
instruction_lines: Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (199 degrees C) according to manufacturer’s instructions.

Combine cream cheese and Cheddar cheese in a small bowl. Divide cheese mixture evenly among jalapeño halves. Top each with a piece of salami, then wrap with a strip of bacon. Secure with a toothpick if necessary.
Arrange jalapeño poppers in a single layer in the air fryer basket, working in batches if needed. Air fry until bacon is browned and crisp and cheese is melted, 10 to 12 minutes.
